current_en: English Terms of Use contains a collection of attributed Richard Stallman quotations.
current_ja: The Japanese Terms page contains an English parody speech inside <div lang="en">.
rationale: This is a deliberate placeholder, not a Japanese translation of the English page. Do not report this surface as fully localized. Its gift rule also wrongly promises receipt only by the intended friend. Decide the intended content first; translating the current unrelated parody would not establish English/Japanese parity.

current_en: Privacy Policy title and a dancing-man video.
current_ja: プライバシーポリシー title and a ferry video.
rationale: Titles and back links are correctly translated; the pages contain different joke videos rather than substantive policy text. Record this as intentional placeholder content, not as a vetted translated policy. This audit makes no legal assessment.

current_ja: 静かなフィヨルドを進むフェリー。画面の上に番組変更のお知らせ
rationale: Natural Japanese description of this page's distinct video. It is not intended as a translation of the English page's different video description. Visual accuracy of every video frame was not assessed.

current_ja: 利用規約 / プライバシーポリシー / 出典 / アプリに戻る
rationale: All static page titles and return links have ordinary, accurate Japanese. The heading repeats the browser title structurally, which is not redundant visible body copy.

current_ja: ギレン・ザビ、ガルマ・ザビ国葬での演説（『機動戦士ガンダム』第12話「ジオンの脅威」、1979年）
rationale: Japanese is grammatical but presents a source attribution above an original English parody. If retaining the joke, explicitly identify it as a parody rather than implying the body is the original speech. No historical source-verification was performed for the episode attribution.

current_ja: 入試モードの題材は、下の出典からつくったリストから配られます。読みと英語を含むこのリストはCC BY-SA 4.0で公開しています。
proposed_ja: 題材は、以下の資料をもとに選んでいます。題材のリスト（読み・英訳を含む）はCC BY-SA 4.0で公開しています。
rationale: から…から is repetitive, 英語 does not name what the English contains, and generic 入試モード weakens the approved mode identity. This page already has subject-source context, so omit the repeated mode label. Preserve the license statement.

proposed_ja: 単語・読み・英訳。
rationale: 英語 is understandable but 英訳 names the supplied information more precisely. JMdict describes a multilingual dictionary; this supports the data role, not every custom sentence here.

current_ja: 漢字の学年。選ぶためだけに使っています。
proposed_ja: 漢字の学年。題材の選定にのみ使用しています。
rationale: Name what is selected. The current Japanese is semantically faithful but underspecified. Keep this role distinct from shipped dictionary content.

current_ja: 語義の確認。選ぶためだけに使い、配布はしていません。
proposed_ja: 語義の確認と題材の選定に使用しています。データはアプリに含めていません。
rationale: Nothing ships means the source data is not included, not necessarily that nothing is distributed anywhere. State the scope and selected object.

current_ja: 題材の種類分け。選ぶためだけに使い、配布はしていません。ライセンスは下にあります。
proposed_ja: 題材の分類に使用しています。データはアプリに含めていません。ライセンスは以下に掲載しています。
rationale: The selection phrase is repeated without adding useful detail to the classification role; naturalize the reference to the following notice while retaining it.

current_ja: 語とWordNetの語義を結ぶため、選ぶためだけに使っています。表示は下にあります。
proposed_ja: 単語とWordNetの語義の対応を、題材の選定に使用しています。著作権・ライセンス表示は以下に掲載しています。
rationale: ため、選ぶため is awkward; bare 表示 is not an adequate translation of the English notice. Name the notice and the purpose clearly.

current_ja: レベル。選ぶためだけに使っています。
proposed_ja: 語彙のレベル。題材の選定にのみ使用しています。
rationale: A level needs its domain and the selection needs its object. Preserve the source author and license labels.

current_ja: 語の頻度。選ぶためだけに使っています。データは CC BY-SA 4.0。
proposed_ja: 単語の使用頻度。題材の選定にのみ使用しています。データのライセンスはCC BY-SA 4.0です。
rationale: More natural and precise description of frequency data. This is editorial localization, not a change to attribution or license terms.

It is separately authored outside the translator export, so it must be included in translation reviews or moved into a shared authoritative message catalog. The missing さん is a neutral-notification tone choice, not a grammatical error; do not mechanically add さん because the fallback name is だれか.

proposed_ja: だれか
rationale: Correct privacy-preserving fallback for a deleted receiver, and it fits the containing Japanese sentence. Keep this separately reviewed backend string; no invented identity.

proposed_en: Draw a sticker in three minutes. Keep it on your board or give it to a friend. Open your sticker board below.
proposed_ja: 3分でかいた絵がシールになります。シールボードに貼ったり、友だちに贈ったりできます。下のメニューからひらいてください。
rationale: Bilingual first-time onboarding is justified because no language is known. Keep the concept and destination, but shorten the English chain and remove Japanese freedom filler. Replace あげる with the approved 贈る. This is editorial brand copy using LINE’s gift vocabulary; no exact Japanese-app match claimed.

proposed_ja: シールボードをひらく
rationale: A single bilingual navigation action is appropriate before the account language is known. It identifies the board destination and uses approved ひらく; no extra helper sentence is needed.

proposed_ja: シールボードをひらく
rationale: The default image is bilingual but its LINE action label is Japanese-only. Preserve a Japanese accessible default and, if LINE’s platform behavior permits, offer language-specific accessible variants after language is known; do not claim full bilingual accessibility from the image alone. Exact remedy depends on LINE action-label character limits.

proposed_ja: クロッキー
rationale: Default chat bar prints both approved app names; returning menus select the account’s language. Appropriate brand identification rather than redundant prose.

proposed_ja: かく
rationale: Both action labels follow the catalog’s approved draw verb and match the image. Japanese intentionally stays in hiragana.

proposed_ja: かく（のこり{{count}}枚）
rationale: Accessible label verbalizes the image’s numeric ticket count. The Japanese counter 枚 is correct, and English singular is handled separately; it is useful accessibility content.

proposed_ja: かく（のこり10枚）
rationale: English compression is deliberate to fit LINE’s action-label limit. Japanese still fits with its counter; no need to force equal string lengths across languages.

proposed_ja: かく（有償チケット）
rationale: Correctly distinguishes reserve from daily tickets and uses the engineer-approved 有償チケット. Do not substitute an inferred free/paid vocabulary.

proposed_ja: かく（チケットなし）
rationale: Accurately says no tickets, but the rendered image also tells the refill time and the accessible label omits it. Consider a compact time-bearing label within LINE’s limit if parity is required. This is a content-equivalence observation, not a Japanese translation error.

proposed_ja: マイボード
rationale: Exact approved navigation term, synchronized conceptually with the catalog-fed image. Short and clear.

proposed_ja: さがす
rationale: Exact approved navigation term in both image and action label. No additional sentence is necessary.

proposed_en: Draw / My board / Explore / count / refill time
proposed_ja: かく／マイボード／さがす／枚数／補充時刻
rationale: Returning menu images read these strings from the app catalog through renderChatMenus.tsx rather than carrying a second translation. The localization status of source catalog keys is handled by their owning audit groups.

proposed_ja: {{time}}（日本時間）に届く
rationale: The image renderer fixes the clock to Asia/Tokyo, unlike an interactive page that can adapt to the viewer’s time zone. The inspected English image only says NEW AT 12:00 AM and Japanese only 0:00に届く. Add a Japan-time qualifier if the chat menu is offered to people outside Japan; this is a content-context issue, not a need to replace the approved refill metaphor.
